text:
jess (People Ops): Quick flag  Raj's passport renewal landed on our radar. Hes in the UK and the new passport won't arrive until next week. That affects I-9 physical verification and the background vendor needs an ID to start. Options below  can we pick one?

raj (new hire): Hi all  yes passport shipping got delayed. I can do a same-day appointment with a local notary tomorrow morning, but they asked if an apostille is required for US employment docs? I'm not sure.

nora (Recruiter): For I-9 specifically, USCIS allows authorized representatives to examine documents on behalf of the employer. Redwood uses an approved notary list for remote hires. Apostille usually applies to foreign public documents; US I-9 won't need an apostille.

jess (People Ops): Correctno apostille for I-9. We need an authorized reviewer to see original ID in-person (passport + secondary). For remote hires outside the US we can: 1) schedule an approved notary (we reimburse up to $60) 2) request the new passport once it arrives and delay final verification 3) do an in-person verification if they can access a partner office. Which is fastest for you, Raj?

raj (new hire): Notary tomorrow morning is best. I can go at 10:00 local. Will the BG vendor start with a passport scan + e-consent?

bg-checks: Hey Raj  we can start pre-screening with a clear color scan of your passport + signed electronic consent. Final clearance requires ID verification later. Please upload to: https://secure-rwinf.bg/upload with reference RW-APPT-1768.

sam (IT): If Day 1 still on schedule, we can provision cloud workstation access so you can join everything even before hardware arrives. We'll send MFA setup steps for Authenticator until YubiKey is delivered.

nora (Recruiter): Quick logistics: Notary list (approved): https://intranet/redwood/notaries. Use the code RED-INTL when booking and save receipt for reimbursement. Please ask the notary to sign their verification form - we need name, stamp, address and date.

notary-bot: System note: When using a non-US notary, ensure the document includes notary stamp + commission number. Upload a photo of the front/back of the passport and the signed notary form. Reimbursement: submit expense with tag "onboarding-notary".

jess (People Ops): Raj  after the notary, please upload: 1) passport scan, 2) notary form, 3) proof of address (utility bill or bank stmt). We'll escalate to BG vendor for identity matching.

raj (new hire): Got it. I'll attend notary 10:00 GMT tomorrow and upload right after. One Q: will delaying I-9 block payroll setup?

jess (People Ops): No, payroll can be created provisionally. Final payroll activation requires completed I-9 verification; we can pay retroactively if necessary.

sam (IT): Also pinging if you want a temporary SSO invite to personal device for Day 1 meetings. I can send a one-time pass and the Zoom calendar.

nora (Recruiter): I've tentatively shifted the crew sync from 09:30 to 11:00 PT on Day 1 to avoid overlap with your notary, Raj. If that doesn't work we can record.

raj (new hire): Appreciate that! 11:00 PT works. Thanks for the flexible timing.

bg-checks: Received preliminary docs reference RW-APPT-1768. We'll begin ID fuzzy-match. If we need additional proof (e.g., national insurance number or second ID), we'll post specifics here within 24h.

jess (People Ops): Action items: - Raj: notary appt 10:00 GMT, upload scans + notary form. - Nora: confirm expense reimbursement flow. - Sam: provision cloud workstation + temp MFA. - BG-checks: start pre-screen and report any gaps.

nora (Recruiter): Reimbursement note: submit receipt in Expensify, tag "onboarding-notary" and People Ops will approve. I'll DM you the expense policy link.

notary-bot: Reminder scheduled: Upload I-9 docs (Raj)  2 hours after notary appointment.

jess (People Ops): Thanks team  looping back after uploads. Raj, welcome again  we'll keep Day 1 smooth.
